name: dsh-session-purge

description.en: Adds a Delete-sessions entry above the workspace list that opens a page listing every session in the workspace, styled like the sidebar itself. Tick rows (tick again to untick), use select-all in the top-right, then Delete in the bottom-right: the sessions move into a recycle bin that restores them byte-for-byte, and only a second, explicit purge clears the session log directory, projection cache, session policy record, workspace membership, cost-meter rows and the attachments nothing else references. Refuses running sessions, the session you are currently viewing, and any path outside the DSH data directory; every destructive call needs confirm:true and the plugin registers no tool and no command.
description.zh: 在工作区列表上方新增「删除会话」入口，点开是一个按侧栏样式排布的会话清单：单击选中、再点取消、右上角一键全选、右下角删除。删除先进回收站（可逐字节完整还原），只有在回收站里二次确认「彻底删除」才会清空会话日志目录、投影缓存、会话策略记录、工作区登记、成本记账与无人再引用的附件。拒绝运行中的会话、当前正在对话的会话与 DSH 数据目录以外的路径；每个破坏性请求都必须 confirm:true，插件不注册 tool 也不注册 command。

capabilityRedLines: deletes files inside the DSH data directory on request (session logs, caches, ledger rows)
